agyos_skill.intent: Record Keeper. Logs every email and call for you, so you never update a CRM by hand again. Reads your inbox through the Gmail connector, matches every message to a contact on the board, and logs it (opening, follow-up or reply) into closer/pipeline.json; logs calls with their notes saved to closer/calls/; shows the full timeline with anyone; and lists new addresses writing in that are not contacts yet. Use when the user says \
